description: This file defines the EntityIdWithResourceType interface, which encapsulates an entity ID along with its resource type, including methods for creation, serialization, and retrieval of its components.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type as a String.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID as an EntityId object.

methods.name: getCacheLookupContext
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing CacheLookupContext for cache lookup.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes the EntityIdWithResourceType object into a String.

methods.name: of (String resourceType, EntityId id)
methods.description: Creates a new EntityIdWithResourceType instance with specified resource type and EntityId.

methods.name: of (String resourceType, EntityId id, CacheLookupContext cacheLookupContext)
methods.description: Creates a new EntityIdWithResourceType instance with specified resource type, EntityId, and cache lookup context.

methods.name: readFrom
methods.description: Deserializes an EntityIdWithResourceType from its string representation.
